summary: Exclude dependency stories from scenario inventory checks with relative-prefixed patterns

replay.detail: No deployed replay or runtime data change.

compatibility.detail: Corrects the dependency exclusion described in the symlink-check release note: leading ../ patterns could still discover real stories inside node_modules and fail the check. Discovery now filters exact node_modules path segments for every supported pattern, agreeing with the symlink walk. Similarly named directories remain included; patterns mentioning node_modules remain unsupported, and symlinks outside excluded dependencies still fail closed.

recovery.detail: No database or runtime recovery change.
